notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow wizards!

This small update seeks to solve a bug that caused the unconfigured controller sign to appear even if no controller was being used.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello fellow wizards!

This is an update a lot of you were asking for.
Not only controller support was added but also the menus were improved to look prettier and facilitate navigability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38081976/11f2ff104e4c58fd620195abda41ea8f31803cba.png

In order to support the vast majority of joysticks, you'll first have to configure your joystick at the config menu.

As always, have a magical day.
